site_name: Land at Wester Hermiston, west of Hermiston House Road / 300m north of 50 Research Avenue North, Riccarton

site_area_m2.claimant: City of Edinburgh Council committee report (24 hectare agricultural field)
site_area_m2.notes: Conflicting claims preserved: council PAN committee paper describes 'an agricultural field comprising of 24 hectares in total'; the developer's Cundall GHG report describes a '77-acre site' (c.311,600 m2), and the local petition says 'over 30 hectares'. The discrepancy may reflect red-line versus wider landholding; unresolved.

building_footprint_m2.claimant: Cundall GHG Emissions report for Apatura Energy
building_footprint_m2.notes: 'Total building footprint of approximately 54,690 m2' across three data centre buildings.

number_of_buildings.claimant: Cundall GHG Emissions report for Apatura Energy
number_of_buildings.notes: Two identical two-storey 48 MW data centre buildings (DC01, DC02) and one single-storey 36 MW building (DC03), plus c.6,300 m2 of office floor area; 136 car parking spaces, 15 accessible spaces, 8 motorcycle and 131 cycle spaces. Heights in metres not published.

current_land_use: Agricultural field (described by objectors as productive prime agricultural land)
protected_designations: Union Canal scheduled monument (SM 11097) to the north
Hermiston Conservation Area to the east
Local Biodiversity Sites bordering north and west

Category A listed Heriot-Watt University Riccarton Estate North Gate Lodge, gatepiers and screen walls (LB 27369) and category B listed Hermiston House west lodge, gate towers, gig-house and boundary walls (LB 27389) nearby
land_notes: Site sits between the Union Canal/M8 to the north and the A71/Riccarton Campus & Business Park to the south, west of Hermiston and the City Bypass, in the Pentland Hills ward. Coordinates are APRS's marker for the site (derived from indicative EIA-document layout), treated as approximate; no red-line boundary has been published on an accessible source, so no boundary polygon is provided.
